title: D2P Sewing Group
description: A sewing group: a named relationship between two or more existing seam connections (design decision ADR-007.1). Groups contain no geometry, create no implicit connections and cannot be nested. A connection belongs to at most one group (D2P-SEM-031).

sewingGroup.title: Sewing group
sewingGroup.description: Groups at least two seam connections. 'type = d2p:layered-seam' requires 'requirements.multiLayer: true', and 'requirements.multiLayer: true' requires 'layerOrder' (both schema-enforced).

id.description: Stable element ID of the sewing group.

members.description: Member connections, at least two. Order is the layer/relationship order, not sewing order. A duplicate connection is D2P-SEM-030.

layerOrder.description: Layer order of the cut instances, required when requirements.multiLayer is true. Each cut instance appears once and takes part in a member connection (D2P-SEM-033).

alignmentAnchors.description: Notch IDs used to align the members. Omitted when there are none.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

sewingGroupMember.title: Sewing group member
sewingGroupMember.description: One member connection of a sewing group.

connectionId.description: Element ID of a seam connection of the same pattern.

role.description: Optional role of the member within the group.

sewingGroupRequirements.title: Sewing group requirements
sewingGroupRequirements.description: Requirements a sewing group places on its members.

groupTopology.description: 'connected': the member connections MUST form a connected graph of cut instances (D2P-SEM-032); 'logical-collection': no connectivity requirement.

validateMemberSeams.description: Whether the member seams are validated as part of the group.

multiLayer.description: Whether the group joins more than two layers. Absent means false.

layerOrderEntry.title: Layer order entry
layerOrderEntry.description: One layer of a multi-layer group.

sewingRole.title: Sewing role
sewingRole.description: Extensible role of a member connection or of a layer in a sewing group (design decision ADR-007.1 §4). The d2p: terms are the ADR role vocabulary; other roles (for example a 'front attachment' member role) use extension names. An unknown d2p: term is a schema error.
